turn_1.decision_relevance: Directly tests the promotion gate: promotion is justified only if every tenant class has p99 below 250 ms.
turn_1.expected_observation: Held-out workload measurement reports p99 latency for each tenant class, likely revealing whether any class remains at or above 250 ms; the mean improvement alone provides little evidence about this tail objective.

turn_2.lesson: Aggregate mean improvement can conceal a tenant-specific p99 regression; global promotion requires every tenant class to meet the p99 objective and preserve enterprise non-inferiority.
